newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso falls amid industry dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso falls amid industry dollar demand.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 1.4 against the dollar to 1,074.5 amid industry demand for greenbacks, interbank traders said.
The flow of dollars into the market was also steady as banks cashed in greenbacks to cover peso shortfalls as they prepared to pay tax bills.
"The dollar supply was soaked up by demand from manufacturing industry and assembly plants," one trader said.
Dealers reported 462 operations worth a total $195. The peso opened at 1,072, hit an intraday high of 1,071 and sank to an intraday low of 1,076.76.
